name: KaspaChat
summary: Private messenger on Kaspa. Messages are end-to-end encrypted, and who talks to whom stays private too. You sign up with a 24-word recovery phrase, not a phone number or email.
status_note: Runs on Kaspa testnet-10. Not on mainnet yet.
self_claimed_note: We build it, and nobody independent has checked it yet.

code.note: The protocol and its contracts are open source. The KaspaChat apps and Kaspaguy's servers are closed source.

conflict: Kaspaguy builds this. It competes with other Kaspa messengers listed here.
